verdict.rationale: Attio's own materials describe 'Ask Attio' for searching, updating, and creating records with AI. Users can also draft follow-ups, schedule next steps, and build workflows just by describing the goal. An official MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT or other AI tools search, update and manage the workspace in natural language. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on Ask Attio's command scope and limits (the evidence is mostly marketing copy), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
